title: Marketing & Social Media Specialist
tools_required: canva; facebook; instagram; tiktok; social media; copywriting; community management; content calendar
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 8 skills: canva, facebook, instagram, tiktok, social media. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
Calling all truly AWESOME people! Looking for a social media WHIZ!

About Stranger Soccer

Stranger Soccer (www.strangersoccer.com) is a Singapore-based company experiencing explosive growth. In a few short years, after launching a revolutionaryplatform and Mobile App for on-demand football, the company has amassed over 50,000 registeredusers playing hundreds of games a week. It has solved the problem that football is the world's #1sport, but is difficult for an individual to play. Stranger Soccer makes it as easy as going to the gym orfor a jog.Browse. Book a slot. Show up and play. Today, it is the #1 way people play football and futsal inSingapore, and is rapidly expanding internationally via a license partner model, with locations in Australia, India, USA, UAE, and SouthAfrica.

Role

The selected candidate will work closely with the UAE Business Owner and a small operations team to manage and grow our social media presence and support key marketing functions. We are looking for an experienced content and social media operator.
key_responsibilities:
- Video editing (short-form reels, match highlights, promo content) using CapCut Pro / Descript
- Graphic design (game announcements, promos, sponsor content) via Canva + AI tools
- Copywriting: post captions, community messages (AI-assisted via Claude/ChatGPT)
- Content scheduling across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook (Buffer / Later)
- Community management: DMs, comments, brand voice consistency
- Monthly/Weekly content calendar planning aligned with our game schedule
- Coordinating with our UAE-based videographer for match-day capture assets
- 3+ years in social media / content role, ideally for a sports, fitness, hospitality, or community brand
- Proven portfolio of short-form video and design output
- Fluent English, strong written communication
- Ability to work independently across UAE and PH time zones (must be available for weekly sync at UAE morning time)

To apply, please send resume to recruitment@strangersoccer.com. Please include cover note, portfolio and salary expectations.
